DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。本日はどのようなお手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What can we help you with today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通帳を記帳しようとしたら、ページがいっぱいという表示が出ました。新しい通帳に替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 印字欄が満杯の表示を説明し新通帳への繰越しを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I tried to update my passbook, it said the pages were full. I'd like to replace it with a new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the printing space is full and request a new passbook. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通帳を拝見します。最後の欄まで印字されていますね。新しい通帳への繰越しを担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see your passbook? It is printed right to the last line. The staff member responsible will check the rollover to a new passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 替えると、前の取引も全部新しい通帳に印字されますか。先月の入金を会社に見せる必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先月入金の提出目的を伝え過去明細も移るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I replace it, will all the previous transactions also be printed in the new one? I need to show last month's deposit to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you need to submit last month's deposit record and ask whether past details will also transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい通帳に過去の明細がすべて写るとは限りません。先月分は今の通帳のどちらにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Not all past transaction details necessarily appear in the new passbook. Where in your current passbook is last month's entry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このページです。ここは読めます。古い通帳を回収されるなら、先にこの部分の記録を残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧通帳の該当ページを示し返却前の記録保存を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: On this page. This part is legible. If you take back the old passbook, I'd like to keep a record of this part first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the relevant page in the old passbook and discuss saving a record before handing it back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 旧通帳をお返しする扱いか担当へ確認しましょう。必要なのは、この一件の入金記録ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check with the staff member whether the old passbook will be returned to you. You need the record of this one deposit, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この通帳を持ち帰れるなら、会社には指定されたページを示します。ほかの取引まで送らずに済むよう、提出方法も会社に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な一件に絞り会社へ提出方法を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If I can take this passbook home, I'll show my company the specified page. I'll also ask the company how to submit it so I don't have to send other transactions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will limit it to the one required entry and ask your company how to submit it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 旧通帳は繰越し後にお返しできます。新しい通帳に続けて記帳する際は、新旧を取り違えないようお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can return the old passbook after the rollover. When you bring a passbook for further updates, please make sure you don't mix up the old and new ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら繰越しをお願いします。古い通帳は先月の記録用、新しい通帳は次の記帳用として分けて保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新旧通帳の用途を分けて保管すると決め繰越しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please roll it over. I'll store them separately: the old passbook for last month's record and the new one for future updates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to store the old and new passbooks separately for different purposes and request the rollover. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 繰越しのご希望として受け付けました。新しい通帳と返却する旧通帳を、担当からお渡しします。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've accepted your request for a rollover. The staff member will give you the new passbook and return the old one. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのクーポンは、今回のお買い物には適用されていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: This coupon has not been applied to your purchase today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この店で買えば使えると思っていました。金額が足りないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 割引未適用が金額不足か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I could use it if I shopped at this store. Is the purchase amount too low?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the discount was not applied because the amount is too low. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金額ではなく、対象の商品が指定されています。下の欄をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's not the amount; specific products are eligible. Please look at the section below.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この種類だけなんですね。今かごにある商品は対象ではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品限定と非対象を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's only this type. The products in my basket aren't eligible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the product restriction and that your items are ineligible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。対象の商品に変更されるか、今回は使わずに購入されるかお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please choose whether to switch to eligible products or buy these without using the coupon today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 割引のためだけに余分な物を買うのはやめます。今の商品は、そのまま買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不要追加を避け現在商品を購入すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't buy extra things just for a discount. I'd like to buy the products I have as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to avoid unnecessary additions and buy the current products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承りました。クーポンは今回使っていない状態でお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. I'll return the coupon to you unused for this purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。使わなかったので、期限内なら別の時に提示できるということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未使用状態と再提示条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Since I haven't used it, does that mean I can present it another time before it expires?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that it remains unused and the conditions for presenting it again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券の利用条件をご確認ください。使用済みにはしていませんが、期限などの条件は残ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the coupon's terms. We haven't marked it as used, but conditions such as its expiry date still apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回は通常の金額で払います。クーポンは未使用のまま持ち帰り、次は対象と期限を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通常支払と対象期限の今後確認を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay the regular price today. I'll take the unused coupon home and check the eligible products and expiry date next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm regular payment and that you will check eligibility and expiry next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この内容でお会計します。クーポンも忘れずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll ring up these items. Please remember to take your coupon too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 犬がリードから離れていますね。飼い主の方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The dog is off its leash. Are you the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。金具が外れました。あの木の近くにいますが、追い掛けると逃げそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人飼犬で金具外れと追走回避を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The clip came undone. It's near that tree, but I think it'll run away if I chase it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it is your dog, the clip came undone, and you want to avoid chasing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職員へ知らせます。通路の向こうへ走らせないよう、落ち着いて場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll notify the staff. Please calmly tell us where it is so we can prevent it from running across the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 木の左側です。小さい茶色の犬で青い胴輪を着けています。道路のほうにはまだ行っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 位置と胴輪特徴と道路未到達を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's to the left of the tree. It's a small brown dog wearing a blue harness. It hasn't gone toward the road yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe its position, harness, and that it has not reached the road. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の職員もそちらへ向かいます。呼ぶと戻って来ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Another staff member is heading that way too. Does it come back when you call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 普段は来ますが、今は驚いています。大声で何度も呼ばず、近くで静かに待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 驚いていて通常呼戻しを強いず静待機を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Usually it does, but it's frightened now. I'd like to wait quietly nearby without calling loudly over and over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it is frightened and you want to wait quietly rather than insist on its usual response to a call. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身も通路へ急に出ないでください。リードの金具は使える状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't step suddenly onto the walkway yourself. Is the leash clip usable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いま見ると曲がっています。同じ金具で付け直しても、また外れそうです。家族が車に予備を持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金具変形を報告し家族の予備を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Looking at it now, it's bent. Even if I attach it with the same clip, it looks likely to come off again. My family has a spare in the car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the bent clip and ask your family for the spare. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家族へ予備を頼んでください。犬の近くの職員へ特徴を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask your family to bring the spare. I'll pass the dog's description to the staff near it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族に予備を持ってきてもらいます。私は位置を見ながら職員を待ち、保護できても散歩は続けず帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予備手配と職員への位置共有で保護後散歩を中止する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll have my family bring the spare. I'll watch where the dog is and wait for the staff, and once it's secured, I'll go home without continuing the walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Arrange the spare and share its position with staff, then stop the walk after recovering the dog. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 職員が木の近くへ向かいます。その場で位置を知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: A staff member is heading to the tree. Please stay there and let us know its position.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅延のご案内をしています。お急ぎのご用事でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: We're providing delay information. Do you have an urgent appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が到着駅まで車で迎えに来ます。いま出発したので、到着の見込みを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えの家族へ到着見込みを伝えるため照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family is coming by car to meet me at the destination station. They've just set off, so I want to tell them my expected arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about expected arrival so you can tell the family member picking you up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの列車は、まだ発車の見込みをご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot yet give an expected departure time for this train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 決まっていないなら、そのまま伝えます。家族は運転中なので、電話ではなくメッセージにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時刻未定を受け運転中はメッセージと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: If it's undecided, I'll tell them that. They're driving, so I'll send a message instead of calling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept that the time is undecided and decide to message the person driving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 安全な所で確認してもらえるよう、連絡するとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be good to contact them so they can check it somewhere safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 送れました。「着くまで駅前で待って」とは頼まず、車を止めてから予定を相談してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 停車後相談の内容で連絡したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've sent it. Instead of asking them to wait outside the station until I arrive, I've asked them to stop the car before discussing our plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that your message asks to discuss plans after stopping the car. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい運行情報が入りましたらお知らせします。他の列車への変更もお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll let you know when we receive new service information. Are you considering switching to another train too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の返事を待ちます。移動すると迎えの駅まで変わるので、今は別ルートを選びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迎え駅が変わるため返事前の別路線選択を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait for my family's reply. Taking another route would also change the pickup station, so I won't choose an alternative route now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold off choosing another route before the reply because it would change the pickup station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。改札内でお待ちになるか、外へ出られるかも、切符の扱いをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please also check the ticket rules before deciding whether to wait inside the gates or go outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで案内と家族の返事を待ちます。駅を変える場合は、迎えの相談と切符の確認を先にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機し駅変更前に家族と切符を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait here for announcements and my family's reply. If I change stations, I'll discuss the pickup and check my ticket first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait, and check with your family and about your ticket before changing stations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 運行情報はこの掲示でも更新します。予定が決まりましたら、切符について窓口でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Service information is also updated on this board. Once your plans are settled, please ask at the counter about your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の件でお越しですね。ご変更でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here about your appointment. Would you like to change it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日の相談に行けなくなりました。仕事が長引くので、欠席の連絡をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当日残業で予約欠席を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can no longer attend today's consultation. Work is running late, so I'd like to let you know I won't be coming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Notify them that you will miss today's appointment because of overtime. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前と予約時刻を確認します。別の日時への変更もご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll confirm your name and appointment time. Would you also like to change it to another date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前はこちらです。来週の勤務がまだ決まっていないので、今日は次の日を決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人情報と次勤務未定を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's my name. Next week's work schedule isn't decided yet, so I can't choose another day today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your details and explain that your next work schedule is undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、今日の予約を取り消す手続きを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I'll check the procedure for cancelling today's appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。空きを一つ押さえて後で変えるより、勤務が決まってから予約し直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仮押さえを避け決定後再予約を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Rather than reserve an open slot and change it later, I'd like to book again once my work schedule is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid a provisional booking and ask to rebook after your schedule is decided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。再予約の案内をお渡しします。相談内容に期限はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I'll give you rebooking instructions. Is there a deadline for the matter you want to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内の締切があるので、ここを見てもらえますか。来週まで待ってよいかは自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相談期限を示し待てるか照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: There's a deadline on this notice. Could you look here? I don't know myself whether it's all right to wait until next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the consultation deadline and ask whether you can wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限に関する点は担当へ確認しましょう。予約取消と、期限の相談を分けておつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the deadline with the staff member responsible. I'll refer you separately for the cancellation and deadline enquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の枠は取り消してください。期限について担当に聞いてから、勤務に合う再予約を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日取消と期限確認後の再予約を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please cancel today's slot. After asking the staff member about the deadline, I'll consider rebooking to suit my work schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm today's cancellation and that you will consider rebooking after checking the deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 取消の内容を記録します。続いて、期限について担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record the cancellation details. Next I'll refer you to the staff member about the deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の書類をご用意しました。お名前をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I've prepared your payment documents. Please check the name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の名前ですね。家族が費用を出してくれたので、家族の名前に変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族負担を理由に領収書宛名変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: That's my name. My family paid the cost, so could you change it to their name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to change the receipt name because your family paid. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受診されたご本人の書類です。家族名にしたい理由を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: These documents concern you as the patient. May I ask why you want them in your family member's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族の会社で費用を申請するそうです。支払う人の名前にすればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族会社申請目的と支払者名の思込みを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They say they'll claim the expense through their company. I thought it should be in the name of the person paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the claim through your family member's company and your assumption about the payer's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受診した方と費用を出した方は別ですね。提出先で必要な書類の条件をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The patient and the person who paid are different people. Please check what documents the recipient requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、受診者を家族に変えるような記載はお願いしません。本人名の領収書で申請できるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受診者の誤記を避け本人書類で提出可能か照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't ask for wording that makes my family member the patient. I'll ask whether they can claim with a receipt in my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid misidentifying the patient and ask whether documents in your own name can be submitted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族から提出先へ確認していただけます。こちらでも発行できる書類の範囲をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your family member can check with the recipient. We can also explain which documents we can issue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族へ連絡しました。まず私の名前の書類で、家族の受診ではないと説明して確認するそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ連絡し本人受診を明示して会社確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've contacted my family. They say they'll first check with the company using the documents in my name and explain that they weren't the patient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report contacting your family and checking with the company while making clear that you were the patient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その領収書を保管してください。追加の書類が必要になれば、名称を確かめてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep that receipt. If additional documents are needed, confirm their names and ask us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は私の名前の領収書を受け取ります。家族が支払ったことは別に説明し、受診者の名前は変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人名書類を受け取り家族支払を別情報にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the receipt in my name today. We'll explain separately that my family paid, without changing the patient's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept documents in your own name and treat the family payment as separate information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの書類をお持ちください。ご本人の氏名と受診日を確認して保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take these documents. Check your own name and consultation date, and keep them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物の連絡についてご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about a message concerning a lost item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: イヤホンを拾ったという人からメッセージが来ました。先に送金すれば返すと言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得者を名乗る返却前送金要求を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone messaged me saying they found my earphones. They say they'll return them if I send money first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about an advance-payment demand from someone claiming to have found your item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その物がお客様のイヤホンと確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed that those are your earphones?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真はありますが、同じ型なだけです。製品番号は相手から示されていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同型写真のみで番号未照合と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's a photo, but they're only the same model. The person hasn't shown me the product number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only have a photo of the same model and have not matched the number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡と確認できた情報を分けて伺います。お金や個人情報を送られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask separately about the messages and the information you've verified. Have you sent money or personal information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。住所も教えていません。自分の番号全部を相手に送る前に、こちらで相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未送金未住所提供で本人番号共有前の相談を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I haven't given my address either. Before sending them my full number, I'd like to consult you here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have sent neither money nor your address and choose to seek advice before sharing your own number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メッセージを残してお見せください。拾得物として届ける方法についても確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the messages and show them to us. We'll also check how they can hand it in as found property.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手と直接会う予定は入れていません。写真だけで自分の物と信じず、正式に届けてもらえるか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未面会で正式届出への切替を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't arranged to meet them directly. Rather than believe it's mine from the photo alone, I'd like advice on having them hand it in officially.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say no meeting is arranged and ask to switch to an official found-property report. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を伺います。なくした場所と、ご自身の製品の資料もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll note your request. Do you also have the location where you lost it and documentation for your own product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: あります。箱の番号と購入記録を見せます。送金は進めず、相手の連絡と私の紛失情報を別に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の購入番号資料と相手連絡を分け送金保留で報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll show the number on the box and my purchase record. I won't proceed with payment, and I'll explain their messages and my lost-item details separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report your own purchase and number documents separately from their messages, while withholding payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当者が資料とメッセージを確認します。元のやり取りは消さずに残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then the staff member will check the documents and messages. Please keep the original conversation without deleting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再配達についてお調べでしょうか。通知をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you enquiring about redelivery? Do you have the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知をなくしました。注文番号ならスマホにあります。これで荷物を探せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知紛失で注文番号から再配達照会を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've lost the notice. I have the order number on my phone. Can you find the parcel with that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the lost notice and request a redelivery enquiry using the order number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文番号と郵便物の追跡番号は別です。発送の案内をご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The order number and postal tracking number are different. Could you check the shipping notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 注文の画面しか開いていませんでした。発送のメールを探してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注文画面から発送メールへ切替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had only opened the order screen. I'll look for the shipping email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Switch from the order screen to the shipping email. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配送の事業者名と追跡番号が分かる部分をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look for the section showing the delivery company's name and tracking number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見つかりました。このメールには別の事業者名が書いてあります。こちらの郵便局ではないようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配送事業者が別と発見する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've found it. This email names another company. It doesn't seem to be this post office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have discovered that the delivery company is different. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その事業者の案内で、問い合わせや再配達の方法をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check that company's instructions for enquiries and redelivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。昨日の紙が郵便局の物だと思ったのも、確認できていませんでした。発送元にも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紙通知も未確認で注文との同一性を発送元へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I hadn't even confirmed that yesterday's paper notice was from the post office. I'll also ask the sender.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the paper notice is unverified too and ask the sender whether it concerns the same order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙の通知を見た荷物と、この注文が同じかも確認するとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would also be good to check whether the parcel on the paper notice is the same as this order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず発送元で荷物を特定します。注文番号だけでここへ再配達を頼まず、配送元と追跡番号を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物と事業者と追跡番号を特定後正しい先へ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first identify the parcel with the sender. I won't request redelivery here using just the order number; I'll confirm the carrier and tracking number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify the parcel, company and tracking number before requesting the correct provider. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その確認をお願いします。お手元のメールは消さずに残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do check that. Keep the email you have without deleting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの再発行をご相談ですね。利用停止はされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a replacement card. Have you had it blocked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、電話で止めました。スマホで残高を見ることもできなくなるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カード停止済みとアプリ残高利用への影響を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I blocked it by phone. Will I also lose the ability to view my balance on my phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the card is already blocked and ask about the effect on viewing the balance in the app. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カードの停止と、口座やアプリの利用の扱いは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the card block separately from how the account and app can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 止めたのはカードだと言われました。アプリを自分で消してしまう前に、今回の範囲を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード停止内容を示し削除前に範囲を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was told it was the card that was blocked. Before deleting the app myself, I want to know the scope of this block.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain what you were told about the card block and check its scope before deleting the app. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付時の内容を確認します。ほかに気になる利用はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the details of your request. Are there any other services you're concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家賃の自動引落です。カードをなくしただけで、口座からの引落も止まると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家賃引落停止の思込みも質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The automatic debit for my rent. I thought losing the card would also stop debits from my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Also ask about your assumption that rent debits would stop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 引落の状態も確認しましょう。停止した範囲を一括りにせず、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the debit status too. We'll explain without treating all the blocked services as one thing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。アプリの表示を見ただけで支払い完了と考えず、家賃の引落予定も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示と支払完了を分け引落予定確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Rather than assume a payment is complete just from the app display, I'll also check the scheduled rent debit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the display from completed payment and ask to check the scheduled debit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 登録と利用状況を拝見します。再発行の説明も、その後に進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll look at your registration and usage status. We'll explain the replacement process after that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停止の受付情報を出します。カード、アプリ、自動引落を別々に確認してから、再発行を申込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三利用を区別して確認後再発行を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll provide the information from the block request. I'd like to check the card, app and automatic debit separately before applying for a replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a replacement after checking the three uses separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご本人確認をして、今回停止した範囲からご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll verify your identity and begin by explaining what was blocked this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先日の交換について、また何かございましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something else happened with the replacement the other day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい水筒もふたから漏れます。二つ続いたので、商品だけでなく使い方も確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交換後も同症状で使用方法も点検希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The new water bottle also leaks from the lid. Since it's happened with two in a row, I'd like you to check how I use it as well as the product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the same problem remains after replacement and ask for a check of how you use it too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご使用の状態を伺います。中のパッキンを洗うために外されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask about how you use it. Did you remove the seal inside to wash it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外しました。戻した向きが合っているか自信がありません。今は空にして持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: パッキン取外しと戻し向き不確実と空現物を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'm not sure I put it back facing the right way. I've emptied it and brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain removing the seal, uncertainty about its orientation, and bringing the empty bottle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品の説明を確認します。こちらではその場で原因や修理方法を断定せず、担当へ照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the product instructions. We won't determine the cause or repair method on the spot here; we'll ask the staff member responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。もう一度交換すれば必ず直るとは考えず、説明の図と今の状態を比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 繰返交換でなく図と状態比較を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Rather than assume another replacement will definitely fix it, I'd like to compare the instruction diagram with its current condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the diagram and current condition rather than keep replacing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明書はお持ちですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。元の交換の控えもあります。二回の購入ではなく、一回購入して一回交換した経緯です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明書と交換控えで一購入一交換を明確化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I also have the record of the original exchange. I didn't buy it twice; I bought it once and exchanged it once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the instructions and exchange record to clarify one purchase and one exchange. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経緯を伝えます。漏れる時の写真もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on that history. Do you also have photos of when it leaks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: あります。使用時の写真と、空の現物、説明書を見せます。次の交換を急がず、確認結果を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真と現物で原因照会し次対応は結果後にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll show the photos from use, the empty bottle and the instructions. I'd like to hear the findings without rushing into another replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the photos and bottle to ask about the cause, and leave the next action until after the findings. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当者へおつなぎします。交換の経緯と、パッキンを外して戻した点から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll connect you with the staff member. We'll start by checking the exchange history and the fact that you removed and reinserted the seal.
